description: Layer 5 neurons in primary somatosensory cortex activated secondary somatosensory cortex through the nonspecific thalamus, and chemically deactivating that thalamic nucleus eliminated the activation (Theyel et al. 2010, as reported by Aru et al.).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Aru et al. 2019. The original study is not read here. It shows a cortical route through the thalamus, not consciousness.

sources.quote: After chemically deactivating the respective thalamic nucleus, the activation of S2 was eliminated
